news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 17%
news.body: After last week's 17% share price gain to ₹11.02, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 35.6x. Average trailing P/E is 22x in the Capital Markets industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 57% over the past three years.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price decline to ₹9.18, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 29.7x. Average trailing P/E is 23x in the Capital Markets industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 25% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.07 (vs ₹0.42 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.07 (up from ₹0.42 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹819.9m (up ₹722.8m from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹26.7m (up ₹33.9m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.3% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 87% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 13% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.5% average weekly change). Earnings have declined by 11% per year over the past 5 years. Market cap is less than US$10m

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹1.44 loss per share (vs ₹0.52 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹1.44 loss per share (down from ₹0.52 profit in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹316.4m (down 18% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹19.7m (down 396% from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 8% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 1% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
